ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal dashed line running through the entire figure, and the thick black line is composed of several slanted line segments, forming the sides of triangles above and below the dashed line. The black line and the dashed line together form a total of 7 equilateral triangles; the horizontal dashed-line part of each triangle is the base, and the black line provides the other two sides. Reasoning: Because each triangle is an equilateral triangle, the sum of the lengths of the two black slanted sides of each triangle is equal to 2 times the length of that triangle's dashed-line base. The dashed-line bases of the 7 triangles together are the whole dashed line, with length 20 cm. Therefore the total length of the black line is 2 × 20 = 40 cm.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows one horizontal dashed segment running across the whole figure, with thick black slanted segments forming seven triangular peaks/valleys above and below that dashed segment. In each triangle, the dashed horizontal portion is the base and the black line supplies the two other sides. From the text, use that all seven triangles are equilateral and that the total dashed line length is 20 cm. Since each equilateral triangle has all three sides equal, the two black sides of each triangle have total length twice that triangle's dashed base. Summing over all seven triangles, the total black length is twice the total dashed base length: 2 × 20 = 40 cm.
